Summary
The letter discusses a collection of photographs, including nude Aboriginal images and a jungle camp scene, alongside a mention of a horseback-riding trip. The sender expresses hope for future correspondence and reflects on the potential future of a naval base in the area. The tone is personal and somewhat nostalgic, with a hint of humor and a mention of a possible military context. The letter concludes with a request for phonograph records and a note about Christmas packages.
